en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European town with a mix of low residential buildings and large institutional complexes. In the foreground stands a prominent circular masonry building with a conical roof and small lantern on top, next to several rectangular buildings and tree‑lined streets. Behind it stretches a long block of barracks- or factory‑like structures with an arched central gate and clock tower. Beyond the town are open fields and low hills. A biplane is flying above the town, slightly left of center. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.
